## Description

## ClassicCastbars

Customizable castbars for Classic WoW. Type "/castbar" to open the options panel.  
Includes optional party & nameplate castbars, school lockout alerts, and basic channel + uninterruptible cast state tracking for Classic Era.

#### Midnight Update

Retail is now currently unsupported until I get the time to look at the new API changes.

#### Classic Era 1.15.0+

This addon is no longer needed for Classic Era to see _target_ castbars. You may safely disable this addon now and enable castbars in `Blizzard Options -> Interface -> Show Enemy Cast Bar` instead.

For anyone still using it for castbar customizations, make sure you're using version 1.7.2+ to support the new built in cast events.  
I no longer actively play, so uninterruptible cast state tracking (grey border shield) is not updated for latest Season of Discovery spells.

# Addon compartment

[Sign In to Save Save](https://auth.fandom.com/signin?
redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fwowpedia.fandom.com%2Fwiki%2FAddon_compartment%3Fcollections%3Dsave&uselang=en&metadata=collections-save-button "Sign In to Save") [Edit](https://auth.fandom.com/signin?redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fwowpedia.fandom.com%2Fwiki%2FAddon_compartment%3Fveaction%3Dedit&uselang=en&metadata=article-registration-edit-article)

* [History](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Addon_compartment?action=history)
* [Purge](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Addon_compartment?action=purge)
* [Talk (0)](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Talk:Addon_compartment?action=edit&redlink=1)

[The addon compartment since . The compartment only appears if at least one button has been registered.](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/wowpedia/images/a/a7/AddonCompartment.png/revision/latest?cb=20230316002932) 

The addon compartment since Patch 10.0.7 . The compartment only appears if at least one button has been registered.
Introduced in World of Warcraft: Dragonflight , the **addon compartment** is a dropdown menu accessible from the minimap that provides a list of clickable buttons registered by installed addons . This is intended to provide an alternative to minimap buttons, suitable for simple use cases such as toggling a UI panel related to an addon.

## Contents

* 1 Integration
  
    + 1\.1 Automatic registration
    + 1\.2 Manual registration
* 2 Patch changes
* 3 References

## Integration [ [](https://auth.fandom.com/signin?redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fwowpedia.fandom.com%2Fwiki%2FAddon_compartment%3Faction%3Dedit%26section%3D1&uselang=en&metadata=article-registration-edit-article-section "Sign in to edit") ]

Addons can register entries into the addon compartment dropdown through the following methods.

### Automatic registration [ [](https://auth.fandom.com/signin?redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fwowpedia.fandom.
com%2Fwiki%2FAddon_compartment%3Faction%3Dedit%26section%3D2&uselang=en&metadata=article-registration-edit-article-section "Sign in to edit") ]

Addons can define the following metadata fields within their TOC file to control the automatic registration of their addon into the compartment. If the addon is load-on-demand, it will be loaded automatically if any of the functions specified in metadata fields need to be called.

|Field Name |Example Value |Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
|AddonCompartmentFunc |`MyAddOn_OnAddonCompartmentClick` |The name of a global function to be executed when the compartment dropdown entry is clicked. This field is required. |
|AddonCompartmentFuncOnEnter |`MyAddOn_OnAddonCompartmentEnter` |The name of a global function to be executed when the compartment dropdown entry is highlighted. Optional. |
|AddonCompartmentFuncOnLeave |`MyAddOn_OnAddonCompartmentLeave` |The name of a global function to be executed when the compartment dropdown entry is no longer highlighted. Optional. |
|IconTexture |`Interface\Icons\TEMP.blp` |The full path or file ID of a texture file to show as an icon in the compartment dropdown. Optional. |
|IconAtlas |`TaskPOI-Icon` |The name of a texture atlas to use as the icon. Optional, and has a lower priority than the IconTexture field if both are set. |

The example below demonstrates the use of these TOC fields.

**MyAddOn.toc**

```
## Interface: 120005
## Title: My Addon
## Notes: Does something neat
## Author: Your Name
 ## AddonCompartmentFunc: MyAddOn_OnAddonCompartmentClick 
 ## AddonCompartmentFuncOnEnter: MyAddOn_OnAddonCompartmentEnter 
 ## AddonCompartmentFuncOnLeave: MyAddOn_OnAddonCompartmentLeave 
## IconTexture: Interface\Icons\TEMP.blp

MyAddOn.lua
```

**MyAddOn.lua**

```
function MyAddOn_OnAddonCompartmentClick ( addonName , buttonName , menuButtonFrame ) 
 print ( "Hello from the addon compartment, clicked with " .. buttonName ) 
 end 
 
 function MyAddOn_OnAddonCompartmentEnter ( addonName , menuButtonFrame ) 
 print ( "Entered my button!" ) 
 end 

 function MyAddOn_OnAddonCompartmentLeave ( addonName , menuButtonFrame ) 
 print ( "Left my button!" ) 
 end
```

### Manual registration [ [](https://auth.fandom.com/signin?redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fwowpedia.fandom.com%2Fwiki%2FAddon_compartment%3Faction%3Dedit%26section%3D3&uselang=en&metadata=article-registration-edit-article-section "Sign in to edit") ]

|[Icon-boilerplate-48x48](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/wowpedia/images/2/26/Icon-boilerplate-48x48.png/revision/latest?cb=20070126025301) |Secure Execution and Tainting

* This method will taint the UIDropDownMenu infrastructure and cause forbidden action errors in other parts of the user interface [[ 1 ]]() .
Use of this method is **strongly** discouraged. |
| --- | --- |

Manual registration into the addon compartment can be performed by calling the [AddonCompartmentFrame:RegisterAddon](https://www.townlong-yak.com/framexml/live/go/AddonCompartmentMixin:RegisterAddon) function, supplying it a table compatible for use with UIDropDownMenu button initialization.

**MyAddOn.lua**

```
AddonCompartmentFrame : RegisterAddon ({ 
 text = "My Addon" , 
 icon = "Interface \\ Icons \\ TEMP.blp" , 
 notCheckable = true , 
 func = function () 
 print ( "Hello from the addon compartment!" ) 
 end , 
 })
```

## Patch changes [ [](https://auth.fandom.com/signin?redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fwowpedia.fandom.com%2Fwiki%2FAddon_compartment%3Faction%3Dedit%26section%3D4&uselang=en&metadata=article-registration-edit-article-section "Sign in to edit") ]
